items.title: Bernie Kirsh interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 27, 2022
items.q: I mean that album... there are three components that go through that album. One is Chick, one is Steve Gadd... So there was no click track, no.

ctx.x: Did they record most of that music with a click track?
Not at all. That was Steve Gadd.
So they had a click track. All right.
